{{Quote|Igpek Droon&mdash;he's a buddy of mine on the Antemeridian route&mdash;he ''hates'' to have even his droids call him 'boss.'|[[Yarbolk Yemm]], to [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]|<ref name="PoT">''[[Planet of Twilight]]''</ref>}}
The '''Antemeridian Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade artery]] that passed through the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> known for its heavy industry.<ref name="CSWE" /> The small-time [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Igpek Droon]] frequented the trade route.<ref name="PoT" />
